claim: The Ten Scenes of West Lake were standardized in 1699 when the Kangxi Emperor inscribed their names; they are Spring Dawn at Su Causeway, Wind and Lotus at the Crooked Courtyard, Autumn Moon over the Calm Lake, Lingering Snow on Broken Bridge, Leifeng Pagoda in Evening Glow, Three Ponds Mirroring the Moon, Orioles Singing in the Willows, Twin Peaks Piercing the Clouds, Viewing Fish at Flower Pond, and Evening Bell on Nanping Hill.
quote: All ten scenes were standardized in 1699 when the Kangxi Emperor inscribed their names... 1. Spring Dawn at Su Causeway 4. Lingering Snow on Broken Bridge 5. Leifeng Pagoda in Evening Glow 6. Three Ponds Mirroring the Moon

claim: Su Causeway, built by poet Su Dongpo in the Northern Song, stretches 2.8km with six bridges and tops the ten scenes for beauty; Broken Bridge sits at the north end of Bai Causeway and Autumn Moon Over the Calm Lake is a 20-minute walk along Bai Causeway to Gushan island.
quote: Spring Dawn at Su Causeway tops the list of the ten best known scenes... Stretching 2.8 kilometers (1.7 miles), it includes six bridges... The Broken Bridge Remnant Snow is situated at the northern end of Bai Causeway.

claim: Three Pools Mirroring the Moon island (Xiaoying / Little Yingzhou) is laid out as 'an island within a lake and a lake within an island', is reachable only by boat, and is the source of the famous full-moon effect created by candles placed in its three stone pagodas during Mid-Autumn Festival.
quote: experience its unique layout of 'an island within a lake and a lake within an island'... local people love to ride boats there, put a lit candle into each of the pagodas and seal the holes with thin white paper

claim: Boats to Three Pools island cost CNY 55 (Leisure Boat) or CNY 70 (Painted Pleasure Boat), both including island admission; they run 08:00-17:00 with the last island boat at 16:00, departing from docks including Hangzhou Park, Children's Palace, Yuewang Temple, Zhongshan Park and Viewing Fish at Flower Harbor.
quote: The Leisure Boat costs CNY 55 per person and the Painted Pleasure Boat costs CNY 70 per person, both of which include admission to the island. Operating hours are 8:00 - 17:00, with the last boat for boarding the island departing at 16:00.

claim: For a short visit the priority sights are Su Causeway (peach blossoms, Song-dynasty history) and the boat trip to Three Pools Mirroring the Moon, plus general lakeside walking of about two hours; boat fees range 55-150 RMB and cruises take 1-2 hours.
quote: For limited time, prioritize: Su Causeway... Three Pools Mirroring the Moon... fees ranging from 55-150 RMB depending on type of boat. Cruises typically take 1-2 hours.

claim: The classic West Lake cycling loop is 12-15km taking 2-3 hours (Hubin Rd -> Nanshan Rd -> Su Causeway -> Beishan Rd -> Hubin Rd); HelloBike (via Alipay, English interface) and the public Diing system (first 60 min free, then 1-2 RMB/hr) are the main bike-share options, but parts of Bai Causeway and the Hubin pedestrian street are strictly no-cycling and Su Causeway gets crowded enough to require dismounting on weekends.
quote: The classic full loop covers 12-15km and takes about 2-3 hours... Diing (Public System): The first 60 minutes are FREE... Parts of the Bai Causeway and the pedestrian-only Hubin walking street are strictly 'No Cycling.' The Su Causeway allows bikes but can be crowded on weekends

claim: A practical one-day West Lake circuit links Broken Bridge -> Autumn Moon/Gushan Park -> boat to Three Pools -> boat to Qianwangci dock -> Orioles Singing in the Willows -> Leifeng Pagoda -> Nanping evening bell -> Su Causeway -> Quyuan lotus garden -> Yuewang Temple.
quote: Duanqiao Canxue -> Pinghu Qiuyue- Gushan Park-> boat to Santan Yinyue-> boat to Qianwangci dock-> Liulang WenYing -> Leifeng Xizhao -> Leifeng Pagoda -> Nanping Wanzhong -> Sudongpo Memorial Hall -> Huagang Park -> Sudi causeway
